sources.author: legendsciber
patch_list: Coins, keys and shop items are granted instantly and free without Google Play billing.
Rewarded ad buttons grant their reward immediately without playing a video, and ad availability is forced ready so shop ad offers work without the ad SDK. Interstitial and banner ads are untouched.
Removes interstitial and banner ads. Depends on Instant Rewarded Ads, so rewarded videos are skipped while their rewards are still granted.
